CMR.note: The notice reports a civil-registration bill passed by the Assembly and says nothing of an authentication service.
The notice names no link between the civil register and the ID system.
A bill on digitising civil registration passed the Assembly, but no digital register is stated as procured, piloted or in service.
No enrolment count or share is given.
The bill introduces a unique personal ID number, but the notice does not say it is given at birth.
Nothing stated on who operates, maintains or owns the ID system.
No public register is stated as keyed on the ID number.
A unique personal ID number is introduced by a bill only; no system, biometrics or certification stated.
The notice says the bill centres on digitising registration but states nothing of local offices entering events digitally.
